QuestInfo.name: Rightful Donation Culture
QuestInfo.0: I should go to #b#m220000000##k and listen in on #b#p2041022##k's problem.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#m220000000##k #b#p2041022##k's problem was more difficult than I imagined.  It's hard enough finding a #b#t04021005##k, but to freely donate it to the king of #b#m220000000##k!?  But if it's true that every great adventurer must learn to generously donate, maybe I need to consider donating as well. 
Plus, according to #b#p2041022##k, the king is a very generous person so it will probably be used to help those in need... This is stressful.
QuestInfo.2: I don't know if I made the right decision, but I gave away #b#t04021005##k to #b#p2041022##k.  I feel like I've somewhat wasted it but I guess it does feel good to know that I've helped someone in need.  Overall, it was a good experience.

0.0: Sigh... What to do... His majesty will be upset again... I just need one... just one... Hm.... Hey! You, there! Would you hear me out for a second?

yes.0: You know, for great adventurers, donating is a very vital part of their identity. Have you ever donated anything? Haha, is that so? That's what I thought. You look like you have all the attributes to be a great adventurer, so why aren't you donating?
yes.1: If you want to donate something, bring me 1 #b#t04021005##k. You can bring it whenever you want. Once you have the #b#t04021005##k, come and talk to me. Haha! You adventurers are truly great!

no.0: Mmm... You're really going to be like that? Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Oh! You finally came! Do you know how long I've been waiting for you? So, did you bring me a #b#t04021005##k? You're still planning to donate it, right?

yes.0: Hehe. Thank you so much! You are my... no you're #b#m220000000##k's hero! Now I can assure his majesty. Our king is such a generous person that this donation will surely be used to help those in need. I can guarantee you that.

item.0: What about the #b#t04021005##k? Ugh... Okay. I'll wait some more.
